_comment: Planet Rush playable milestones (GDD 4.6 / 4.6a). Entries are milestones (M0-M7); the `day` field on each entry is a milestone index, not a calendar day. The deploy workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) pings ntfy on a v* tag with the play URL and the matching entry's `test_notes`. Lookup: .tags[<tag>] first, else .default. As the team tags a milestone, add a `tags` entry pointing at that milestone's notes below. `days` is the source of truth for the notes text (GDD 4.6).

default.title: New build
default.test_notes: A new tagged build is live. Open it on your phone: verify touch controls and keyboard both work, and that it installs to the home screen.

v0.1.title: Classroom release
v0.1.test_notes: Full flow end-to-end: main menu, settings, an 8-slot match with bots, and the end-of-match / Rematch screen. Touch and keyboard both working; runs at 60 fps on your phone.

v0.1.0-m1.title: Milestone 1 — the ship, in your hands
v0.1.0-m1.test_notes: On your PHONE: twin sticks fly the ship (nose banks into motion), hold-to-FIRE mines an asteroid, ore HUD fills, chunks stay put when your hold is full, the beam stops at what it hits, landscape behaves, and the corner badge tells you exactly which build this is. Two minutes. Your thumbs-up closes M1 and opens M2: planets, turrets, war.

days.title: Concept + tone locked; repo, CI, deploys live; netcode spike decided
Ship flies, shoots, mines
days.test_notes: Fly the ship, hold fire on an asteroid to mine it, watch the two-number ore HUD fill. First onboarding prompts fire. Touch twin sticks and fire-mode setting work alongside keyboard/mouse and gamepad.

days.title: Planets, defenses, win/loss
days.test_notes: Build turrets, a shield, and run the repair channel at your planet; trigger the under-attack alarm. Win/loss and the last-to-die rule fire against do-nothing bots.

days.title: 2-player online
days.test_notes: WebSocket transport + authoritative server are live. Join a room and confirm a 2-player online match plays and stays in sync.

days.title: Lobby, classes, bots
days.test_notes: 8-slot lobby with room codes, ship-class select, and player colors. Easy/Medium/Hard bots with personalities fill empty slots, online and offline.

days.title: Integration & performance gate
days.test_notes: A full 8-slot online match runs end-to-end at 60 fps on integrated graphics and on the phone. First balance pass; art/VFX/audio replace placeholders.

days.title: Balance & polish
days.test_notes: Match length lands in the 10-15 minute target. Gamepad and touch verified; onboarding polished.

days.title: Classroom release
days.test_notes: Full flow end-to-end: main menu, settings, an 8-slot match with bots, and the end-of-match / Rematch screen. Touch and keyboard both working; runs at 60 fps on your phone.
